name: Mahou Shounen ★ Lyrical Heart!
original_name: 魔法少年★リリカルハート!
source:
Koiba Kokoro is a male student who dreams to become a magical girl.

He has wanted to be a magical girl since he was a child, but was always told that boys cannot become magical girls.

But then a rabbit fairy from another world named "Pipimaru" appears in front of Kokoro and...!?
